search_window.basis: Previous verified Food Line supplementary watch completion through current observation. Page crawl freshness and source publication dates are distinguished from new developments.

coverage_notes.purpose: Bounded supplementary Food Line miss-class recall, not authoritative nationwide production collection.
target_classes: Loss/closure/fire/disaster affecting only, sole, last or full-service grocery store
Canceled/suspended emergency food distribution due to storm, flood, fire, outage or facility damage
Abrupt food pantry/food-bank closure or major access reduction
New official SNAP/WIC/EBT/food-assistance interruption with immediate access consequences
bounded_query_context: "only grocery store" closed fire November 5 2026 town
"food bank" "distribution" suspended fire power outage November 5 2026

reviewed_candidates.exclusion_reason: Sole grocery store fire is a genuine target class but September 14 report is historical and was reviewed in the preceding heartbeat; no new interval development.
Old October 2025 notice about potential November 2025 SNAP funding suspension; not November 2026 current interruption.

Official site search snippet lists an October 27 water-related DPHSS office closure and routine November 28 WIC clinic closure; no new immediate food-assistance disruption was confirmed. Direct source fetch timed out.

source_failures.detail: Direct open of official Guam Department of Public Health and Social Services homepage failed with timeout. Search-index excerpt remained available; no new qualifying SNAP/WIC interruption was verified.

coverage_notes.result: No newly verified sole/last/full-service grocery loss, emergency-food distribution cancellation, abrupt pantry/food-bank service reduction, or official immediate SNAP/WIC/EBT interruption in bounded hourly interval.
coverage_notes.limitations: Fresh search results were dominated by older September 2026 sole-store loss, January 2026 and earlier grocery losses, 2025 SNAP materials, and unrelated announcements. A single auxiliary official Guam source timed out, so conservatively DEGRADED rather than SUCCESS; meaningful broad coverage remained. This is not exhaustive national monitoring.
coverage_notes.materiality: The single timeout did not materially compromise the four-class recall coverage or reveal a new event; no new qualifying signal and no notification-level operational failure verified.
coverage_notes.action_limits: No approvals, publication, scheduling changes, automation disabling or modifications to production collector.
